# Appendix C: Validation Checklists

Use these checklists during onboarding, quarterly audits, and the Chapter 20 capstone. Mark each item **Pass / Fail / N/A** with a date and evidence path.

## Security baseline

| # | Check | Pass | Evidence |
|---|-------|------|----------|
| S1 | Ubuntu 24.04 LTS on all managed guests (`lsb_release -rs`) | | |
| S2 | SSH password authentication disabled (`sshd -T`) | | |
| S3 | Root SSH login disabled | | |
| S4 | Admin access limited (`AllowUsers` / few sudoers) | | |
| S5 | Fail2ban or equivalent on internet-facing SSH | | |
| S6 | UFW (or nft) default deny inbound; only required ports | | |
| S7 | Public listeners inventoried (`ss -tulpn`) — no surprise 0.0.0.0 binds | | |
| S8 | Azure NSG/home firewall aligned with guest exposure | | |
| S9 | Secrets not in git plaintext; file modes 0600 where used | | |
| S10 | Break-glass console procedure documented and tested once | | |
| S11 | unattended-upgrades or explicit patch cadence configured | | |
| S12 | Kernel/package reboot policy known | | |
| S13 | WireGuard (or admin path) keys protected; WG not world-open without need | | |
| S14 | TLS for public HTTP services; cert expiry monitored | | |
| S15 | Admin UIs not publicly anonymous | | |

**Sign-off:** _______________ **Date:** _______________

## Backup / restore validation

| # | Check | Pass | Evidence |
|---|-------|------|----------|
| B1 | Data inventory exists; every service has a class | | |
| B2 | `/etc` included in backup set | | |
| B3 | `/srv` (or documented data roots) included | | |
| B4 | Secrets backup encrypted / password manager export offline | | |
| B5 | Automated job (systemd timer/cron) active | | |
| B6 | Last backup timestamp within RPO for critical data | | |
| B7 | Offsite copy in separate failure domain | | |
| B8 | `restic check` or equivalent integrity OK | | |
| B9 | File-level restore tested ≤ 90 days | | |
| B10 | VM/image restore tested ≤ 90 days for P-class hosts | | |
| B11 | Restore test cleaned up (no IP/name collisions left) | | |
| B12 | DR runbook exists for edge host loss | | |
| B13 | Measured RTO recorded vs target | | |
| B14 | Proxmox vzdump / Azure snapshots scheduled where used | | |
| B15 | Backup monitoring alert on failure | | |

**Sign-off:** _______________ **Date:** _______________

## Observability baseline

| # | Check | Pass | Evidence |
|---|-------|------|----------|
| O1 | Node metrics on each Ubuntu host (exporter or equivalent) | | |
| O2 | Metrics not exposed to open internet | | |
| O3 | Uptime checks for each P/H service critical path | | |
| O4 | At least three actionable alerts defined | | |
| O5 | Each alert has a runbook link | | |
| O6 | Alert notification path tested end-to-end | | |
| O7 | Logs for critical units accessible (`journalctl`) | | |
| O8 | Disk space metrics/alerts present | | |
| O9 | Certificate expiry visibility (monitor or calendar) | | |
| O10 | “What we do not monitor” list documented | | |
| O11 | SLO-lite defined for ≥2 critical services (if claimed) | | |
| O12 | Weekly ops review notes exist or scheduled | | |
| O13 | Dashboards reachable via private path / auth | | |
| O14 | Time sync healthy on monitored hosts | | |
| O15 | Overlay/VPN path monitored if services depend on it | | |

**Sign-off:** _______________ **Date:** _______________

## Deployment readiness

| # | Check | Pass | Evidence |
|---|-------|------|----------|
| D1 | Service has catalog blueprint entry | | |
| D2 | Runtime justified per placement policy | | |
| D3 | Health check command/URL works | | |
| D4 | Restart policy verified (`systemd`/compose) | | |
| D5 | Survives host reboot test | | |
| D6 | Config in git or documented path | | |
| D7 | Secrets via EnvironmentFile/secret store — not baked in image | | |
| D8 | Ingress/DNS updated and documented | | |
| D9 | Firewall/NSG updated | | |
| D10 | Backup job covers new data paths | | |
| D11 | Monitor/alert added for P/H class | | |
| D12 | Rollback steps tested or at least written | | |
| D13 | Resource limits considered (RAM/disk) | | |
| D14 | Idempotent deploy path (playbook/compose) preferred | | |
| D15 | Change logged (PR/tag/changelog) | | |

**Sign-off:** _______________ **Date:** _______________

## Network & hybrid connectivity

| # | Check | Pass | Evidence |
|---|-------|------|----------|
| N1 | IPAM document matches live addresses | | |
| N2 | netplan backups exist before changes | | |
| N3 | Reboot retains addressing | | |
| N4 | DNS resolution internal + external as designed | | |
| N5 | Overlay handshake healthy (`wg show`) | | |
| N6 | Private service reachable only as intended | | |
| N7 | Public exposure matrix reviewed | | |
| N8 | Console recovery notes for netplan failure | | |
